view.scene_description: A wide-angle view inside a large warehouse with high ceilings and fluorescent lighting. A gray car with its trunk open is parked near tall blue and red metal racks filled with boxes. A person in a dark jacket stands by the car loading items. Yellow carts and a forklift are nearby. The floor is concrete, and the space appears active with logistics operations.

objects.label: person
objects.observation: A person wearing a dark jacket and jeans stands beside the open trunk of a gray car. They appear to be handling boxes. Their back faces the camera, and they are positioned centrally in the frame near the vehicle's rear.

objects.label: gray car
objects.observation: A gray compact SUV with its trunk open is parked in the aisle. The rear bumper and taillights are visible. Boxes are inside the trunk, and the person is interacting with them. It is located in the center-left of the image, partially obstructed by the person.

objects.label: yellow cart
objects.observation: A yellow metal cart with wire mesh sides is positioned on the right side of the frame. It contains stacked white and red boxes. It is stationary on the concrete floor, near other equipment and boxes.

objects.label: forklift
objects.observation: The front portion of an orange forklift is visible on the far right edge of the image. Its wheel and part of the chassis are seen. It is parked near stacked cardboard boxes and appears stationary.

objects.label: warehouse racks
objects.observation: Tall blue and red metal storage racks line the background and sides of the warehouse. They are filled with various boxes and goods. Some racks have labels like 'AA 02' and 'AA 03'. They extend into the distance, creating depth in the scene.

objects.label: cardboard boxes
objects.observation: Multiple cardboard boxes are scattered around the scene. Some are on the ground near the car, others are inside the trunk, and some are stacked in the yellow cart. They vary in size and are mostly brown or white with markings.

objects.label: ceiling lights
objects.observation: Fluorescent light fixtures are mounted on the high ceiling, providing illumination. They are arranged in rows and emit bright light. Their reflections can be seen on the polished concrete floor below.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s3-36694", "image_size": [1280, 720], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
